title: Build a CRUD API with FastAPI and Database
description: Create a complete REST API with FastAPI, Pydantic validation, SQLAlchemy database, and test it using Swagger UI
objective: Students will build a fully functional REST API with CRUD endpoints, Pydantic data validation, SQLAlchemy database integration, search/filter/pagination, and test everything using Swagger UI auto-documentation

steps.title: Set Up FastAPI Project and Database Models
steps.instructions:
Create a new project folder and install all dependencies:
```bash
mkdir student-api
cd student-api
pip install fastapi uvicorn sqlalchemy aiosqlite
```

Create `main.py` with the database setup and SQLAlchemy models:

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, ForeignKey, select, func
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship, DeclarativeBase
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# Database setup
DATABASE_URL = "sqlite+aiosqlite:///./techpath.db"
engine = create_async_engine(DATABASE_URL, echo=False)
async_session = async_sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)

class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass

async def get_db():
    async with async_session() as session:
        yield session

# Models
class CourseDB(Base):
    __tablename__ = "courses"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, unique=True)
    duration_months = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    fee = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    students = relationship("StudentDB", back_populates="course")

class StudentDB(Base):
    __tablename__ = "students"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    email = Column(String(100), nullable=False, unique=True)
    city = Column(String(50), default="Bhopal")
    marks = Column(Float, default=0.0)
    course_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("courses.id"), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    course = relationship("CourseDB", back_populates="students")

# FastAPI app
app = FastAPI(title="TechPath Student API", version="1.0")

@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup():
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    print("Database tables created!")

@app.get("/")
async def home():
    return {"message": "TechPath Student API is running!", "docs": "/docs"}
```

Run the server:
```bash
uvicorn main:app --reload
```

Open `http://localhost:8000` and `http://localhost:8000/docs` in your browser. You should see the Swagger UI with the home endpoint.

**Checkpoint:** The server starts without errors and Swagger UI loads.

steps.title: Create Pydantic Schemas and Response Models
steps.instructions:
Add Pydantic models to `main.py` for request validation and response formatting. Place these **after** the SQLAlchemy models and **before** the app:

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator, ConfigDict
from typing import Optional, List

# --- Course Schemas ---
class CourseCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=100)
    duration_months: int = Field(ge=1, le=36)
    fee: float = Field(ge=0)

class CourseResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int
    name: str
    duration_months: int
    fee: float

# --- Student Schemas ---
class StudentCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=100, description="Full name")
    email: str = Field(description="Email address")
    city: str = Field(default="Bhopal", max_length=50)
    marks: float = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=100)
    course_id: Optional[int] = None

    @field_validator("email")
    @classmethod
    def validate_email(cls, v):
        if "@" not in v or "." not in v:
            raise ValueError("Invalid email format")
        return v.lower().strip()

    @field_validator("name")
    @classmethod
    def validate_name(cls, v):
        if not v.strip():
            raise ValueError("Name cannot be blank")
        return v.strip()

class StudentUpdate(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = Field(None, min_length=2)
    city: Optional[str] = None
    marks: Optional[float] = Field(None, ge=0, le=100)
    course_id: Optional[int] = None

class StudentResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int
    name: str
    email: str
    city: str
    marks: float
    course_id: Optional[int]
    created_at: datetime
```

Save and check that the server reloads without errors.

**Try the validation:** In Swagger UI, try POST `/api/students` (once you add it in the next step) with `marks: 150` — it should reject with a 422 error.

**Checkpoint:** Pydantic models compile without errors.

steps.title: Build CRUD Endpoints (Create, Read, List)
steps.instructions:
Add the Create, Read, and List endpoints. Also add a startup event to seed sample data:

```python
# Seed sample data on startup (add this inside the existing startup function)
@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup():
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)

    # Seed data if empty
    async with async_session() as db:
        result = await db.execute(select(func.count(CourseDB.id)))
        if result.scalar() == 0:
            courses = [
                CourseDB(name="Python Full Stack", duration_months=12, fee=45000.0),
                CourseDB(name="ADCA", duration_months=12, fee=25000.0),
                CourseDB(name="DCA", duration_months=6, fee=15000.0),
            ]
            db.add_all(courses)
            await db.flush()

            students = [
                StudentDB(name="Rahul Sharma", email="rahul@email.com", city="Bhopal", marks=85, course_id=1),
                StudentDB(name="Priya Patel", email="priya@email.com", city="Indore", marks=92, course_id=1),
                StudentDB(name="Amit Kumar", email="amit@email.com", city="Delhi", marks=78, course_id=2),
                StudentDB(name="Sneha Verma", email="sneha@email.com", city="Pune", marks=88, course_id=2),
                StudentDB(name="Vikram Singh", email="vikram@email.com", city="Bhopal", marks=71, course_id=3),
            ]
            db.add_all(students)
            await db.commit()
            print("Sample data seeded!")

# --- CREATE endpoint ---
@app.post("/api/students", status_code=201)
async def create_student(data: StudentCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    # Check for duplicate email
    result = await db.execute(select(StudentDB).where(StudentDB.email == data.email))
    if result.scalar_one_or_none():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"Email '{data.email}' already exists")

    student = StudentDB(**data.model_dump())
    db.add(student)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(student)
    return {"success": True, "data": StudentResponse.model_validate(student)}

# --- LIST endpoint ---
from fastapi import Query

@app.get("/api/students")
async def list_students(
    search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search by name"),
    city: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by city"),
    skip: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = select(StudentDB)
    if search:
        query = query.where(StudentDB.name.ilike(f"%{search}%"))
    if city:
        query = query.where(StudentDB.city.ilike(city))
    query = query.offset(skip).limit(limit)

    result = await db.execute(query)
    students = result.scalars().all()
    return {
        "success": True,
        "total": len(students),
        "data": [StudentResponse.model_validate(s) for s in students],
    }

# --- GET BY ID endpoint ---
@app.get("/api/students/{student_id}")
async def get_student(student_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    result = await db.execute(select(StudentDB).where(StudentDB.id == student_id))
    student = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not student:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Student not found")
    return {"success": True, "data": StudentResponse.model_validate(student)}
```

Test in Swagger UI (`http://localhost:8000/docs`):

| Test | Expected |
|------|----------|
| GET `/api/students` | Returns 5 seeded students |
| GET `/api/students/1` | Returns Rahul Sharma |
| GET `/api/students/999` | 404 error |
| POST `/api/students` with valid data | 201 + new student |
| POST with `marks: 150` | 422 validation error |
| POST with existing email | 409 conflict |
| GET `/api/students?city=Bhopal` | Only Bhopal students |
| GET `/api/students?search=pri` | Only Priya |

**Checkpoint:** Create, List, and Get endpoints all work in Swagger UI.

steps.title: Add Update, Delete, and Search Endpoints
steps.instructions:
Add the remaining CRUD endpoints and a stats endpoint:

```python
# --- UPDATE endpoint ---
@app.put("/api/students/{student_id}")
async def update_student(
    student_id: int, data: StudentUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    result = await db.execute(select(StudentDB).where(StudentDB.id == student_id))
    student = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not student:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Student not found")

    # Only update fields that were actually sent
    for key, value in data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():
        setattr(student, key, value)

    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(student)
    return {"success": True, "data": StudentResponse.model_validate(student)}

# --- DELETE endpoint ---
@app.delete("/api/students/{student_id}")
async def delete_student(student_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    result = await db.execute(select(StudentDB).where(StudentDB.id == student_id))
    student = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not student:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Student not found")

    await db.delete(student)
    await db.commit()
    return {"success": True, "message": f"Deleted student: {student.name}"}

# --- STATS endpoint ---
@app.get("/api/stats")
async def get_stats(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    total = await db.execute(select(func.count(StudentDB.id)))
    avg = await db.execute(select(func.avg(StudentDB.marks)))
    highest = await db.execute(select(func.max(StudentDB.marks)))

    return {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "total_students": total.scalar() or 0,
            "average_marks": round(avg.scalar() or 0, 1),
            "highest_marks": highest.scalar() or 0,
        }
    }
```

Also update the list endpoint to support sorting:

```python
@app.get("/api/students")
async def list_students(
    search: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    city: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    sort: str = Query("id", description="Sort by: id, name, marks"),
    order: str = Query("asc", description="asc or desc"),
    skip: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = select(StudentDB)
    if search:
        query = query.where(StudentDB.name.ilike(f"%{search}%"))
    if city:
        query = query.where(StudentDB.city.ilike(city))

    sort_col = {"id": StudentDB.id, "name": StudentDB.name, "marks": StudentDB.marks}.get(sort, StudentDB.id)
    if order == "desc":
        sort_col = sort_col.desc()
    query = query.order_by(sort_col).offset(skip).limit(limit)

    result = await db.execute(query)
    students = result.scalars().all()
    return {
        "success": True,
        "total": len(students),
        "data": [StudentResponse.model_validate(s) for s in students],
    }
```

Test these new endpoints:

| Test | Expected |
|------|----------|
| PUT `/api/students/1` with `{"marks": 95}` | Rahul's marks updated to 95 |
| PUT `/api/students/999` | 404 error |
| DELETE `/api/students/5` | Success message |
| DELETE `/api/students/999` | 404 error |
| GET `/api/students?sort=marks&order=desc` | Sorted by marks descending |
| GET `/api/stats` | Total, average, highest marks |

**Checkpoint:** All CRUD operations, sorting, and stats work.

steps.title: Test All Endpoints with Swagger UI
steps.instructions:
Now do a complete test of every endpoint using Swagger UI at `http://localhost:8000/docs`.

### Complete Test Checklist

For each test, click the endpoint in Swagger, click "Try it out", fill in the parameters, and click "Execute".

| # | Test | Endpoint | Input | Expected Result |
|---|------|----------|-------|-----------------|
| 1 | List all students | GET `/api/students` | (none) | 200, returns seeded students |
| 2 | Search by name | GET `/api/students?search=rah` | search=rah | Only Rahul |
| 3 | Filter by city | GET `/api/students?city=Bhopal` | city=Bhopal | Bhopal students only |
| 4 | Sort by marks | GET `/api/students?sort=marks&order=desc` | sort=marks, order=desc | Highest marks first |
| 5 | Pagination | GET `/api/students?skip=0&limit=2` | limit=2 | Only 2 students |
| 6 | Get by ID | GET `/api/students/1` | student_id=1 | Rahul's data |
| 7 | Get missing | GET `/api/students/999` | student_id=999 | 404 error |
| 8 | Create student | POST `/api/students` | `{"name": "Neha Gupta", "email": "neha@email.com", "city": "Hyderabad", "marks": 90}` | 201, new student |
| 9 | Create invalid | POST `/api/students` | marks=150 | 422 validation error |
| 10 | Create duplicate | POST `/api/students` | same email | 409 conflict |
| 11 | Update marks | PUT `/api/students/1` | `{"marks": 95}` | 200, marks updated |
| 12 | Delete student | DELETE `/api/students/3` | student_id=3 | Success message |
| 13 | View stats | GET `/api/stats` | (none) | Summary statistics |

**Take a screenshot** of each test result in Swagger UI.

### Also check ReDoc

Open `http://localhost:8000/redoc` to see the auto-generated read-only documentation. Notice how your Pydantic schemas appear as request/response models.

### Verify the Database

Install and open DB Browser for SQLite to see the `techpath.db` file. You should see the `students` and `courses` tables with your data.

**Submit:** Your complete `main.py` file + screenshots of all 13 Swagger UI tests + one screenshot of ReDoc.
